caseStudies.title: Online Ordering Platform & Automated Box Count Detection
caseStudies.summary: A distributor ordering platform paired with an image-based box counting system that verifies dispatch quantities on the production floor.
caseStudies.challenge: Orders from distributors and dealers arrived by phone call, WhatsApp, and paper slips. There was no single record of what had been ordered, confirmed, or dispatched, and reconciling them consumed hours of the sales team's day. On the dispatch floor, box counts were tallied by hand — a slow process where a miscount was only discovered after the consignment had already left.
caseStudies.solution: We built a dedicated online ordering platform where distributors place and track their own orders against a live catalogue, with confirmation and dispatch status visible to both sides. Alongside it we developed a box count detection system that uses image-based counting to verify quantities at the point of dispatch, flagging mismatches against the order before the consignment is loaded.
outcomes: Digitised distributor ordering, cutting order processing and reconciliation time
Automated box counting at dispatch, eliminating manual tally errors
Real-time order and stock visibility for the operations team
A single auditable record of every order from placement to dispatch

caseStudies.title: Automated Audit Report Generation
caseStudies.summary: An automation tool that turns raw client financial files into structured, formatted audit reports without manual re-entry.
caseStudies.challenge: During audit season, teams were rebuilding the same report structure for every client by hand — copying figures between spreadsheets, cross-checking totals, and reformatting documents. The work was repetitive, slow, and every manual transfer was an opportunity for an error that would only surface at review.
caseStudies.solution: We built an automation tool that ingests client financial files and generates the audit report directly from them. Figures are pulled and cross-checked programmatically, the report structure and formatting stay identical across every client, and validation runs flag inconsistencies before the document reaches a reviewer.
outcomes: Raw client financial files converted into formatted audit reports automatically
Sharp reduction in manual data entry and cross-checking during audit season
Consistent report formatting and structure across every client file
Validation checks that surface inconsistencies before review, not after

caseStudies.title: Godown Inventory & Billing Management System
caseStudies.summary: One platform covering inventory tracking, stock movement, and billing across multiple large godowns.
caseStudies.challenge: Large godowns operating under APMC Hubli tracked inward and outward stock in paper registers. Knowing current stock meant physically checking, and billing was prepared separately from the movement records it was supposed to reflect — so the two regularly disagreed, and reconciling them was manual.
caseStudies.solution: We built a management system that records every inward and outward movement as it happens and derives both stock position and billing from that single record. Warehouse staff get real-time visibility of what is held where, and invoices are generated directly from recorded movement rather than re-entered.
outcomes: Real-time inventory tracking across multiple large godowns
Billing generated directly from recorded stock movement
Reduced dependency on manual ledgers and paper registers
Consistent stock and billing figures that reconcile by default

caseStudies.title: SaaS Billing Platform with a Shop-Optimised Mobile App
caseStudies.summary: A subscription billing platform for gold retail, with a mobile app built around how billing actually happens at the counter.
caseStudies.challenge: Billing in a gold shop is never a flat price. Every invoice depends on the day's rate, the weight and purity of the piece, making charges, wastage, any old gold being exchanged, and GST on top. Working that out on a calculator while a customer waits at the counter is slow, and a single mis-keyed figure changes the value of the sale. Stock and customer purchase history were tracked separately again, by hand.
caseStudies.solution: We built a SaaS billing platform for jewellery retail, delivered with a mobile app designed for counter use rather than a desk. Staff enter the item by weight and purity, the current rate and making charges are applied automatically, old gold being exchanged is deducted, and a GST-compliant invoice is generated and shared with the customer in the same flow. The same bill updates stock and the customer's purchase history, so the records stay in step without re-entry.
outcomes: Billing at the counter in a fraction of the time, with the rate applied automatically
Rate, making charge, wastage, and exchange calculations no longer done by hand
GST-compliant invoices generated and shared directly with the customer
Stock and customer purchase history updated from the bill itself
Runs on a phone or tablet at the counter, delivered as a subscription

about.title: About Shakti Softwares
about.lede: A Hubli-based engineering team building operational software for businesses that run on precision.
story: Shakti Softwares builds the systems that businesses in and around Hubli actually run on — the platform a distributor places an order through, the register that tracks what is sitting in a godown, the tool that turns a folder of client files into a finished audit report.

We work with manufacturing and distribution businesses, agricultural trade and warehousing operations, and professional services firms. Each one came to us with a process that worked on paper and phone calls but had stopped scaling, and each one needed software shaped around that specific process rather than a product they would have to bend themselves to fit.

We are deliberately a small team. It means the person who understands your operation is the same person writing the code, and the same person who picks up the phone two years later when you want to add another godown or another report format.
